package postgres

import (
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

func TestMigration022AddsBoundedPathOutcomeInboxAndFailsClosedDown(t *testing.T) {
	_, current, _, ok := runtime.Caller(0)
	require.True(t, ok)
	root := filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(current), "../../../../"))
	up, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, "db/migrations/022_teacher_onboarding_path_outcome.up.sql"))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	down, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, "db/migrations/022_teacher_onboarding_path_outcome.down.sql"))
	require.NoError(t, err)

	for _, required := range []string{
		"BEGIN;", "COMMIT;", "CREATE TABLE teacher_onboarding_path_outcome_inbox",
		"event_id UUID PRIMARY KEY", "execution_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE", "handoff_id UUID NOT NULL",
		"status IN ('PATH_READY', 'ACTIVE_PATH_EXISTS', 'STATE_CHANGED')",
		"course_id UUID", "learning_path_id UUID", "first_lesson_id UUID",
		"status = 'PATH_READY'", "dialog_message_id IS NULL", "delivered_at >= accepted_at",
		"teacher_onboarding_path_outcome_handoff_idx",
		"trg_protect_teacher_onboarding_path_outcome_identity",
		"trg_protect_teacher_onboarding_path_outcome_delete",
		"trg_protect_teacher_onboarding_path_outcome_truncate",
		"BEFORE DELETE ON teacher_onboarding_path_outcome_inbox",
		"BEFORE TRUNCATE ON teacher_onboarding_path_outcome_inbox",
		"teacher onboarding path outcome identity is immutable",
		"teacher onboarding path outcome delivery acknowledgement is immutable",
		"teacher onboarding path outcome evidence cannot be deleted",
		"teacher onboarding path outcome evidence cannot be truncated",
	} {
		require.Contains(t, string(up), required)
	}
	for _, forbidden := range []string{
		"profile_json", "prompt_body", "provider_error", "raw_provider_error", "graph_json", "assistant_ui",
	} {
		require.NotContains(t, strings.ToLower(string(up)), forbidden)
	}
	require.Contains(t, string(down), "BEGIN;")
	require.Contains(t, string(down), "LOCK TABLE teacher_onboarding_path_outcome_inbox IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE")
	require.Contains(t, string(down), "cannot roll back migration 022: onboarding path outcome evidence is retained permanently")
	require.Contains(t, string(down), "DROP TRIGGER trg_protect_teacher_onboarding_path_outcome_truncate")
	require.Less(t, strings.Index(string(down), "RAISE EXCEPTION"), strings.Index(string(down), "DROP TABLE teacher_onboarding_path_outcome_inbox"))
}
